prompt.title: 走路 · 侧面循环（walk）
prompt.rule: WALK CYCLE. The clip is one complete walk cycle, played in place, and it must read as walking from the first frame to the last. Go through all four poses in order: contact (both feet apart, front heel down, back toe down), down (front knee bent, hips at their lowest), passing (the back leg swings through, the knee lifted so the foot clears the ground), and up (hips at their highest, both legs nearly straight). Then the same four again with the legs swapped, and close on the pose the clip opened with.

STRIDE. The stride is wide and clearly visible: the front foot lands well in front of the hips and the back foot pushes off well behind them, so the gap between the two feet is roughly one and a half head-widths at the contact pose. He never shuffles with his feet close together.

FEET. The foot that is on the ground stays flat and planted. The foot that is off the ground is lifted clear of the floor, with the knee leading. No foot slides along the ground while it is supposed to be planted.

ARMS AND TORSO. The arms swing opposite to the legs, the forward arm bending at the elbow, and the shoulders counter-rotate a little against the hips. The torso leans forward very slightly at the contact poses and stands up at the passing pose. The head stays level and faces the direction of travel the whole time.

IN PLACE. He walks as if on a treadmill: the feet move backwards under him and the body stays on exactly the same spot of the canvas for the whole clip. He is never translated across the frame, the camera never follows him and he never drifts or changes size.
